items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: That's the same way with Sonny Johnson... He is a great man. And he can play a lot of clarinet too.

ctx.x: He can drink anything you drink, but he just gets to rambling mind or something.

I don't know. A lot of people are scared of him. He's allowed to hire him and he's allowed to jump up and leave any minute if he gets to drinking. Not long as he's not drinking, he loves to work. He loves to play them instruments. All of them. But that's the trouble. You have to stop him from playing sometimes when he's not drinking. He's allowed to. He's allowed to leave.
